scope: Prospective safeguards for every future promotion claim. Existing historical panels are not retroactively corrected for the full adaptive search; the current control is retained rather than re-promoted.
uniqueUnit: One unique week/seed; two paired policy worlds form one paired observation. Repeated runs are operational checks or development, not added independent evidence.
retirement: A seed used for training, tuning, diagnosis, selection, or any prior run is never fresh again. Changes influenced by a validation outcome require an entirely new panel.
selectionLog: Record every model and policy screened, its frozen source/settings/model, development seed IDs, all attempts and outcomes, and the decision. Development comparisons can select candidates but do not justify promotion.

freezeBeforeAnyPlay: complete cryptographically random seed panel disjoint from the registry and all reserved panels
fixed sample size and interruption rules
futureValidation.analysisTiming: Analyze for promotion only after the complete frozen panel and operational audit. No favorable interim stopping, panel enlargement after seeing results, failed-world deletion or silent replacement.

multiplicity.family: All future promotion attempts after effectiveAt, including attempts following a failed panel
multiplicity.lookIndex: j starts at1 and is allocated before the first validation world; never reuse a spent index
multiplicity.assumptions: Alpha spending accounts for repeated candidate selection with genuinely fresh panels. Mean-profit t/bootstrap inference still depends on independent-week and distributional/approximation assumptions; allocation alone does not make those methods distribution-free.

profitGate.oneSidedPairedMeanTest: At the allocated alpha, require a positive lower bound for mean paired gain using the predeclared paired-t method and a paired bootstrap sensitivity check. Report both and their assumptions; no post-hoc choice of a favorable method.

reliabilityGate.qualificationReport: Report the one-sided exact binomial lower confidence bound at the allocated alpha under IID-week sampling, even with zero observed failures. Passing a small panel is not a safety guarantee.
reliabilityGate.audit: Retain and inspect every action error, recovery, fine and failed attempt. Any uncertainty remains explicit.

futureValidation.failureRule: A failed or interrupted validation panel cannot promote. Retain all observed outcomes; any follow-up redesign treats its seeds as development and spends the next validation allocation on new seeds.
